key_insight: AdaRoll-GRPO adaptively allocates rollouts across training questions to improve GRPO performance under the same total rollout budget.
engineering_relevance: Difficulty-aware rollout allocation can make LLM post-training more effective without adding online allocation-policy optimization.
method: Formulate rollout allocation as sequential decision-making under a fixed total budget.
Use a Bayes-adaptive MDP to compute an adaptive allocation policy offline.
Apply the learned policy during GRPO training instead of allocating uniformly.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent improvements over GRPO across multiple reasoning datasets and LLM architectures at a fixed rollout budget, but provides no numerical results.
watch_item: Offline policy computation adds setup work, and transfer to new models or question distributions should be validated.
paper_title: Bayes-Adaptive MDPs for Rollout Allocation to Enhance GRPO Training
